mathematical_audit.envelope_split: The cofactor u=1 interval has exact length 2/35. Every other allowed cofactor is at least 5, placing its prime divisor below L_M and inside the safely removed factorial support. Subtracting 2/35 from C6 gives the stated exact C_comp.
mathematical_audit.atomicity: Because each matched factor divides its row label and U_M<2L_M, a prime at least L_M can divide only the row bearing that same prime label. Thus every sharp row factor is either one or its colliding prime row label.
mathematical_audit.overlap: For distinct rows, any common matched divisor divides both row labels and hence their difference, which is below L_M. Low-prime saturation removes it; sharp factors are pairwise coprime and lcm height equals product height.
mathematical_audit.ray_one: When r is 1 modulo 6, p is 5 modulo 6 and t^3=2^(p-2)=1/2. Cubing is bijective, so the phase equation is automatically soluble.
mathematical_audit.ray_five: When r is 5 modulo 6, p is 1 modulo 6 and t^3=2^(p-1)=1. The selected phase lies in the cubic roots of unity, so this equation is also automatically soluble.
mathematical_audit.scope: The proved eta=0 belongs to pairwise matched-factor overlap and phase-only reciprocity methods. It does not assert that the actual collision density has eta zero or exclude unmatched cross-row and moving-target arithmetic.
